items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Wasn't the same thing with Pete Lawley, you know. The guy running the roof guard, he got jealous of the place.

ctx.x: They were taking everyone to jail. Wasn't the same thing with Pete Lawley, you know. The guy running the roof guard, he got jealous of the place. Well it was.
Was that during Prohibition already? What they raided for?
